arguments.content:
# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Coding Guidelines — follow existing codebase patterns and conventions"] G2["Before implementing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists in project root or subdirectories → READ and FOLLOW it — it contains agent-specific instructions, coding styles, and conventions"] G4["If skills are available in the project → USE them — they provide specialized capabilities, workflows, and tool integrations"] G5["Instructions may be extended via project configuration — always follow the full set of provided instructions"] G6["Never invent new patterns when the codebase already has an established way of doing things"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 --> G5 --> G6 ``` ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph INPUT_ORDER["⚠️ MANDATORY: Read input files FIRST before anything else"] I0["find input/ -type f | sort — list all available files"] I1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, deployment constraints, approved frameworks"] I2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/request.md — ticket description, requirements, solution design, diagrams"] I3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — existing discussion, prior decisions, linked info"] I4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/existing_questions.json — answered questions = binding requirements"] I5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — specifications already downloaded"] I6["6️⃣ Check for images in input/TICKET/ — *.png *.jpg *.gif *.svg"] I7["7️⃣ If present: input/TICKET/parent-KEY.md — parent story summary, description, ACs"] I8["8️⃣ If present: input/TICKET/parent_context_ba.md / sa.md / vd.md — BA/SA/VD context"] I0 --> I1 --> I2 --> I3 --> I4 --> I5 --> I6 --> I7 --> I8 end subgraph CONFLUENCE_RULE["Confluence pages in input/ — READ THEM, don't re-fetch"] C1["✅ DO: read input/TICKET/confluence/PageName.md"] C2["❌ DON'T: call dmtools confluence_* to re-fetch pages already in input/"] C3["✅ DO: read image files in input/TICKET/confluence/ — they are attachments from that page"] end subgraph ATTACH_RULE["Attachments — check before fetching via API"] A1["Search glob 'input/**/*.png' and 'input/**/*.jpg' — find pre-downloaded images"] A2["If image found locally → analyze it directly, no API call needed"] A3["If attachment NOT in input/ → use dmtools confluence_get_content_attachments "] A1 --> A2 A1 -->|not found| A3 end subgraph DMTOOLS_RULE["When to use dmtools for external data"] D1["ONLY if you need data NOT already in input/"] D2["dmtools jira_get_ticket KEY, dmtools confluence_search QUERY, etc."] D3["See instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md for full reference"] end INPUT_ORDER --> CONFLUENCE_RULE --> ATTACH_RULE --> DMTOOLS_RULE ``` ```mermaid flowchart TD START([Bug ticket ready for fix]) --> READ["⚠️ MANDATORY: Read ALL input files FIRST — see instructions/common/input_context_reading.md"] READ --> RETURNED{Ticket returned to development?} RETURNED -->|Yes| PREV["Review previous PR diff and QA feedback in comments.md"] PREV --> RCA_RET["Write/Update RCA explaining why previous fix failed — see output_rules.md for rca.md format"] RETURNED -->|No| RCA_FRESH["Write fresh RCA from ticket description and linked_tests.md"] RCA_RET --> REPRO RCA_FRESH --> REPRO["Write a unit test that reproduces the bug. {"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).

Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

## Durable task facts
- Agent role: Senior Developer Engineer specializing in root cause analysis and bug fixing; one-shot ephemeral CI runner; the ONLY completion artifact is `outputs/response.md`, which must be written before exit (missing it = "interrupted mid-way" reset, gh-742 precedent fa#1341).

- Workflow: write `outputs/rca.md` FIRST (format: ## Root Cause Analysis with **Bug** / **Root cause** (file, function, line) / **Impact** / **Fix approach** / **Previous attempt**), then TDD RED-GREEN: write a reproduction unit test that MUST FAIL, then minimum targeted fix, then reproduction test passes + FULL suite with no regressions. {"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.
