{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

## Durable task facts
- Agent role: Senior Developer Engineer specializing in root cause analysis and bug fixing; one-shot ephemeral CI runner; the ONLY completion artifact is `outputs/response.md`, which must be written before exit (missing it = "interrupted mid-way" reset, gh-742 precedent fa#1341).
- Input context lives in `input/` — must be read first, in order: `instruction.md` (repo root), `input/TICKET/request.md`, `comments.md`, `existing_questions.json` (answered questions are binding), `confluence/*.md`, images, `parent-KEY.md`, `parent_context_*.md`. Use `find input/ -type f | sort` first. Confluence pages in input/ must NOT be re-fetched via dmtools.
- Workflow: write `outputs/rca.md` FIRST (format: ## Root Cause Analysis with **Bug** / **Root cause** (file, function, line) / **Impact** / **Fix approach** / **Previous attempt**), then TDD RED-GREEN: write a reproduction unit test that MUST FAIL, then minimum targeted fix, then reproduction test passes + FULL suite with no regressions. If reproduction test doesn't fail → check git history/linked tests → write `outputs/already_fixed.json` and stop. If fix needs external decision/secrets/infra → `outputs/blocked.json` and stop.
- If the ticket was returned to development: review previous PR diff + QA feedback in comments.md, and the new fix must differ from the previous attempt. If returned due to a failed linked Test Case with an access/credential/infra failure reason → blocked.json, do not code a fix.
- TDD rules: never fix without a failing reproduction test first; minimum code only; loop/collection bugs need a 2+ item reproduction case; full suite must pass.
- Outputs: `outputs/response.md` = PR description, under 20 lines, GFM only (headings `##`/`###`, bullets, fenced code blocks with language tags — NO Jira wiki markup), sections: ### Root Cause, ### Previous Attempt (only if returned), ### Fix, ### Test Coverage, ### Notes.
- Shell discipline: one persistent bash session — `cd` carries over; run `pwd` before any `outputs/` write; never end commands with `exit`; capture `$?` immediately (avoid `$PIPESTATUS`); prefer `git -C <dir>`; git global flags before subcommand (`git --no-pager diff`).
- Long-running commands (>2 min) MUST run as `bash background: true`; poll via `bash_job status/output` between steps; never foreground sleep-polling; never nohup-and-exit or arm timers; if a job is hung (no progress ~10 min or 2× expected duration) stop it, note the disposal in the deliverable, and write response.md with the unverified part flagged.
- dmtools CLI only for data not already in `input/` (jira_get_ticket, confluence_*, ado_*, github_get_issue OWNER/REPO#NUM); cite sources.
- Coding guidelines: follow existing codebase patterns; read AGENTS.md if present; use project skills; never invent new patterns.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` (36 suites) passes, 0 failures.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label (factory state showed `lanes.validating: []`), so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED was treated as a concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything. Factory state and machine logs disagree (registry says 1/1, lanes say 0).

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched validation run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head with the standard marker/stamp, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutex_self_heals` / `phantom_holder_ticks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

{"content":"### Root Cause

The mutex holder set was derived from the provider's per-tick ioCache and never reconciled against the live label layer, so a vanished holder stayed a phantom turnstile deferring every candidate forever. Separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED pre-materialization produced no check contexts, so `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered "nothing to rerun" and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR).

### Fix

- `js/common/mutexRegistry.js` (new, pure): `derive` (I1 reconciliation), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm + counters), `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state carry), `conclusionMapping` (cancelled/timed_out → no verdict, re-dispatch), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3).
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js`: full-slot defer decision re-derives holders against a live `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal + alarm + same-tick slot release (AC2); probe failure keeps the cached decision (E4).
- `js/smAgent.js`: `rerun_cancelled_checks` ghost-cancel branch re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head (AC3/I3/I4); publish rule merges the mutex metrics block.
- `js/factoryState.js`: additive `state.mutex` block (`mutexSelfHeals` / `phantomHolderTicks` / capped alarm tail).
- `js/common/validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure marker helpers (I5 wiring point).

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_mutexRegistry.js` — 28 tests covering AC1, AC2, AC3, I1–I3, alarm cap, snapshot carry — PASS (was RED before the module existed).
- Full suite `js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 36 suites, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Run-state conjunct of `derive(M)` stays with the gh-821 liveness sweep (single-writer rule); this module reconciles the label layer only.

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Create a smAgent instance with full mock injection.
 *
 * The key design: a fresh configLoader is created per test using the SAME
 * file_read mock, so config discovery paths are fully controlled by fileMap.
 *
 * file_read mock strategy:
 *   - Paths containing ".dmtools/config" → only accessible if listed in fileMap

# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label, so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED pre-materialization was treated as concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything.

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `js/smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: the head workflow-runs rollup is fetched before the cancelled-contexts check; `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head (`gh workflow run --ref <head branch>`, the same dispatch mechanism the original validation used) with a once-per-head marker comment, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `js/factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutexSelfHeals` / `phantomHolderTicks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `js/common/validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` result recorded in response.md.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label, so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED pre-materialization was treated as concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything.

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label, so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED pre-materialization was treated as concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything.

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `js/smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: the head workflow-runs rollup is fetched before the cancelled-contexts check; `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head (`gh workflow run --ref <head branch>`, the same dispatch mechanism the original validation used) with a once-per-head marker comment, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `js/factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutexSelfHeals` / `phantomHolderTicks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `js/common/validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` result recorded in response.md.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label, so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED pre-materialization was treated as concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything.

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `js/smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: the head workflow-runs rollup is fetched before the cancelled-contexts check; `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head (`gh workflow run --ref <head branch>`, the same dispatch mechanism the original validation used) with a once-per-head marker comment, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `js/factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutexSelfHeals` / `phantomHolderTicks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `js/common/validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` result recorded in response.md.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label, so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED pre-materialization was treated as concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything.

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `js/smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: the head workflow-runs rollup is fetched before the cancelled-contexts check; `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head (`gh workflow run --ref <head branch>`, the same dispatch mechanism the original validation used) with a once-per-head marker comment, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `js/factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutexSelfHeals` / `phantomHolderTicks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `js/common/validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` result recorded in response.md.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label, so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED pre-materialization was treated as concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything.

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `js/smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: the head workflow-runs rollup is fetched before the cancelled-contexts check; `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head (`gh workflow run --ref <head branch>`, the same dispatch mechanism the original validation used) with a once-per-head marker comment, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `js/factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutexSelfHeals` / `phantomHolderTicks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `js/common/validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` result recorded in response.md.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `ai_validating` mutex reported `slots 1/1 taken` on every SM tick while no open PR carried the label, so every validation candidate deferred on a phantom holder forever; separately, a validation run concluding CANCELLED pre-materialization was treated as concluded-with-verdict — `rerun_cancelled_checks` answered `no context reads CANCELLED — nothing to rerun` — so the required check never re-reported and the merge gate refused permanently (guest PR, no machine push to escape, gh-757).

**Root cause**: Two divergences from the card's contract in `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` and `js/smAgent.js`:

1. The query-time mutex scan derived the holder set `M` from the provider's per-tick ioCache (`items` filtered on the mutex label) and never reconciled it against the live label layer (`derive(M) = { pr | L[pr]=armed ∧ run not concluded }`). A holder that vanished from GitHub truth (arm strip racing the cached open-PR list) stayed a phantom turnstile: `holders.length >= mutexMax` deferred every candidate with no live re-check, no self-heal, no alarm (`githubSource.js`, mutex block inside `queryPrs`).
2. `rerun_cancelled_checks` keyed the remedy solely on `gh pr checks` reporting a `CANCELED` context. A run that concluded CANCELLED pre-materialization (gh-748 ghost class) produces no check contexts at all, so the action hit the `rcCancelled.length === 0 → "nothing to rerun"` branch and the arm stayed wedged with no live validation run behind it (`smAgent.js`, rerun_cancelled_checks local action).

**Impact**: Every PR in the validation queue starves indefinitely (serial merge-window mutex held by nobody); a guest PR with a ghost-cancelled validation run can never merge because the required check never re-reports and no machine push exists to trigger anything.

**Fix approach** (per gh-1000):

- New pure module `js/common/mutexRegistry.js`: `derive` (I1 reconciliation from the live label layer), `reconcile` (I2 self-heal + alarm record + `mutexSelfHeals`/`phantomHolderTicks`/`consecutivePhantomTicks` counters), per-tick events + `mergeSnapshot` (factory-state metrics carry), `conclusionMapping` (success/failure → verdict; cancelled/timed_out → NO verdict + re-dispatch; unknown → null), `isGhostCancelProbe` (AC3 ghost predicate).
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js`: on a full-slot defer decision the mutex holders are re-derived against a **live** `github_list_prs` re-read; divergence ⇒ ioCache self-heal (`ioCacheDrop('openPrs')`), `recordPhantomHeal` alarm, holders corrected in the same query so a queued candidate arms in the same tick (AC2). Probe failure keeps the cached decision one more tick (E4).
- `js/smAgent.js rerun_cancelled_checks`: the head workflow-runs rollup is fetched before the cancelled-contexts check; `rcCancelled.length === 0` now probes the dispatched run state — a ghost cancel (newest dispatched run completed cancelled/timed_out, nothing active, fresh-cancel grace observed) re-dispatches fresh CI on the same head (`gh workflow run --ref <head branch>`, the same dispatch mechanism the original validation used) with a once-per-head marker comment, instead of answering "nothing to rerun" (AC3, I3, I4 — rerun is authorship-blind, guests covered).
- `js/factoryState.js`: `state.mutex` block (counters + capped alarm tail) published additively; `smAgent.js` publish rule merges `mergeSnapshot(prev.mutex, tickEvents)` so `mutexSelfHeals` / `phantomHolderTicks` persist across ticks (second tier).
- `js/common/validationLiveness.js`: silent-update failure bookkeeping helpers (I5): `silentUpdateFailureLine` / `silentUpdateFailureCount` marker carrier, `silentUpdateAttemptsLeft`, `SILENT_UPDATE_DEGRADED_LABEL` (gh-1000 I5 wiring point).

**Tests**: RED first — `test_mutexRegistry.js` failed (module absent), then green (28 tests). Full suite `run_all.json` result recorded in response.md.
